title: 16.3 An on-Device Generative AI Focused Neural Processing Unit in 4nm Flagship Mobile SoC with Fan-Out Wafer-Level Package
problem: On-device generative AI (LLMs like LLaMA, visual models like Stable Diffusion) exhibit fundamentally different computational characteristics than traditional CNNs: LLMs are memory-intensive with streaming weight reads (GB per token), while visual models are compute-intensive with softmax/layernorm dominating (40% of ops vs. 90-99% for conv in CNNs), requiring heterogeneous compute architecture.
motivation: On-device AI is shifting from camera-centric CNNs to transformer-based generative models; a single homogeneous tensor engine cannot efficiently support both memory-bound and compute-bound workloads, necessitating specialized hardware.
method: The chip includes two specialized tensor engines: one optimized for language models that need to continuously read large weights from memory, another for vision models that require intensive matrix calculations. A multi-level memory system with on-chip storage and DRAM tiling efficiently caches weights to reduce repeated memory fetches. Fan-out wafer-level packaging improves heat dissipation for sustained high performance. Built at 4nm in Samsung's Exynos 2400, it supports traditional image processing (CNNs), language models (LLMs), and image generation models.
key_novelty: Two specialized tensor engines on a mobile chip, each optimized for different AI workloads: one for language models that need fast memory access, one for vision models that need fast computation.
contributions: First mobile on-device NPU supporting LLM inference (weight streaming)
Heterogeneous vector + dual-tensor architecture for CNN/LLM/LVM support
FOWLP thermal management enabling sustained generative AI performance
limitations: Abstract does not provide quantitative performance metrics (TOPS, memory bandwidth, latency), power consumption, memory footprint, or actual LLM/vision model latencies vs. baselines.
primary_theme: heterogeneous mobile NPU for LLM and vision generative AI
